estilo: Children's picture-book illustration of a Bible story for kids aged 6 to 11. Soft watercolor and gouache with visible paper texture, delicate outlines, warm luminous palette (ochre, amber, soft blues and greens). Friendly, expressive characters with storybook proportions (slightly large heads), simple clothing of the ancient Middle East, warm brown skin tones of the region. Nothing scary, no violence, no blood: tender and hopeful mood. No text, no letters. Full-bleed artwork: the painting fills the entire canvas to every edge and corner, with no white paper margin, no vignette, no oval or circular frame and no border. Wide horizontal composition with the main subject centered and some breathing room around it.

escenas.creacion: The very beginning of creation: an enormous golden light bursting into being at the center above dark, calm waters. The sky shifts from deep night blue with stars to a warm dawn. No people.
escenas.arcoiris: A big rainbow over green hills after the rain. Noah's wooden ark rests on a hill. Noah and his family, small in the scene, look up at the sky while animals (giraffes, elephants, sheep) walk down in pairs.
escenas.mar: The Red Sea parted into two tall walls of blue water on each side, with a path of dry sand in the middle. The people of Israel cross with children, sheep and bundles. Moses with his staff leads in front. Dawn light.
escenas.david: Young shepherd boy David, small and brave, holding a sling with a pouch of smooth stones, facing the giant Goliath in bronze armor (imposing but not frightening, seen at a distance). Grassy valley, clear sky. No injuries.
escenas.daniel: Daniel kneeling calmly in prayer inside a stone lions' den, a beam of light coming in from an opening above. A softly glowing angel barely visible, and gentle sleeping lions lying beside him.
escenas.jonas: A huge friendly blue fish swimming in the sea under a sky clearing after a storm. A small ship far away on the horizon. Jonah is visible inside the fish's open mouth, praying, small and not afraid.
escenas.navidad: Starry night in Bethlehem. A humble stable with Mary, Joseph and baby Jesus in the manger, wrapped in cloths. Shepherds with sheep approach. A bright star and a soft glow of angels in the sky.
escenas.tormenta: A wooden fishing boat on the Sea of Galilee with big waves and rain. The disciples are scared, and Jesus stands with his hand stretched out toward the sea. On one side the clouds open and a ray of sunlight comes through.
escenas.panes: A green hillside full of people sitting in groups. In the foreground, a boy offers Jesus a basket with five loaves of bread and two fish. Andrew stands beside them. Golden afternoon light.
escenas.zaqueo: Zacchaeus, a short man in fine clothes, peeking out between the branches of a sycamore tree. Below, Jesus looks up at him smiling and waves to him. A crowd around them on a street of Jericho.
escenas.oveja: A kind shepherd walking happily across rolling hills carrying a little lost lamb on his shoulders. The flock in the distance. Warm sunset.
escenas.resucito: Sunrise in a garden. The tomb carved in rock is open and empty, the large round stone rolled to one side. A radiant angel sits on the stone, and two women (Mary Magdalene and the other Mary) arrive surprised and joyful. Flowers in the foreground.
